headline: Ashok Leyland reports 23% growth in total sales for October
hook: Strong commercial vehicle demand drives October growth

Medium and Heavy Commercial Vehicle sales grew 28% to 13,927 units compared to 10,865 units in the previous year. Meanwhile, the Light Commercial Vehicle segment registered a 14% rise, reaching 7,961 units. This sustained sales momentum signals healthy industrial activity and freight demand for Indian auto investors.
